title: 埃博拉医院缺粮缺水：家属送餐反成感染通道，谁来保障患者和家属的安全？
speaker: Declan Walsh

segments.en: Declan I also want to ask you I want to focus on something you talk about because you report that the hospital has no food or water to give to ailing patients.
segments.zh: 我想聚焦你提到的一点：医院没有食物和水提供给病患。

segments.en: You know when you're giving HIV medication when you're giving tuberculosis medication when you're giving supportive care that supportive care can't work if your patient is malnourished or you don't have clean water and it's often the part of the response that it seems to get lost in the shuffle.
segments.zh: 当你提供HIV药物、结核病药物或支持性护理时，如果患者营养不良或没有干净的水，支持性护理就无法发挥作用。而这部分应对措施常常被忽略。

segments.en: Are there any efforts being made to address that piece of this what is needed and and where do you think it should be coming from.
segments.zh: 是否有任何努力来解决这个问题？需要什么？应该来自哪里？

segments.en: But very I mean certainly the world food program have mobilized in this area they're set their mounting feeding programs and so on but you know that there are two issues with that firstly as you say you know in a hospital like this.
segments.zh: 世界粮食计划署已在该地区动员，设立了喂养项目等。但有两个问题：首先，在这样的医院里，通常不提供食物或水。

segments.en: They just don't generally for normal treatment to provide food or water.
segments.zh: 他们通常不提供食物或水作为常规治疗。

segments.en: The families are generally responsible for bringing food to the people.
segments.zh: 家属通常负责给患者送食物。

segments.en: They come in they provide the food now that is providing a biosecurity hazard in this environment because family members come in unprotected to provide food to people.
segments.zh: 他们进入病房送食物，这造成了生物安全危害，因为家属在没有防护的情况下进入。

segments.en: And run a high risk of being contaminated themselves.
segments.zh: 他们自己也有很高的感染风险。

segments.en: The other issue is in terms of people's ability to fight this virus because this virus is a it's a rare virus that as yet has no vaccine and no cure.
segments.zh: 另一个问题是人们抵抗病毒的能力。这种病毒很罕见，目前没有疫苗和治愈方法。

segments.en: The only way to treat it really is to bolster the defenses of a person who is sick in order that their own body can fight that virus.
segments.zh: 唯一的治疗方法是增强患者的防御能力，让他们的身体自己对抗病毒。

segments.en: And obviously food water IV drips all of these very basic you know not even medical treatments but certainly basic things to bolster their immune system are key.
segments.zh: 显然，食物、水、静脉输液等基本措施——甚至不是医疗手段——但增强免疫系统的关键。

segments.en: And that's why if if the medical authorities are going to successfully start to push back this wave of infections they're going to have to get those pieces in places as well.
segments.zh: 因此，如果医疗当局要成功遏制这一波感染，他们必须把这些基本措施落实到位。
